meta.title: Battle Dialogue · Primordial Reconstruction
meta.description: What sort of world will you create once you make up your mind to stop hesitating?

units.rawText: I'm sorry, Fresnel...
units.displayText: I'm sorry, Fresnel...

spans.text: I'm sorry, Fresnel...

units.rawText: Hubble looks back at the spaceship through the escape pod's window, and smile apologetically.
units.displayText: Hubble looks back at the spaceship through the escape pod's window, and smile apologetically.

spans.text: Hubble looks back at the spaceship through the escape pod's window, and smile apologetically.

units.rawText: I'm sorry for bringing the backups for Belka and the others on the ship without telling you.
units.displayText: I'm sorry for bringing the backups for Belka and the others on the ship without telling you.

spans.text: I'm sorry for bringing the backups for Belka and the others on the ship without telling you.

units.rawText: I'm sorry, because I knew from the beginning that we wouldn't have enough mass... from the moment I got Anna's message...
units.displayText: I'm sorry, because I knew from the beginning that we wouldn't have enough mass... from the moment I got Anna's message...

spans.text: I'm sorry, because I knew from the beginning that we wouldn't have enough mass... from the moment I got Anna's message...

units.rawText: It's from Anna... Ah... It's the message Xuannu left behind... She finally finished analyzing it, I see...
units.displayText: It's from Anna... Ah... It's the message Xuannu left behind... She finally finished analyzing it, I see...

spans.text: It's from Anna... Ah... It's the message Xuannu left behind... She finally finished analyzing it, I see...

units.rawText: This part of the message concerns the use of the cipher key and things of note...
units.displayText: This part of the message concerns the use of the cipher key and things of note...

spans.text: This part of the message concerns the use of the cipher key and things of note...

units.rawText: In other words... We need to get rid of all the mass in the Jiutian sector.
units.displayText: In other words... We need to get rid of all the mass in the Jiutian sector.

spans.text: In other words... We need to get rid of all the mass in the Jiutian sector.

units.rawText: Perhaps we can sacrifice mass from outside the sector... But...
units.displayText: Perhaps we can sacrifice mass from outside the sector... But...

spans.text: Perhaps we can sacrifice mass from outside the sector... But...

units.rawText: We can use the stuff in the ship to make up for the mass of the data drives Xuannu mentioned just now, but then we still have Xinghuan's, Yuwang's, and the other agents' backups...
units.displayText: We can use the stuff in the ship to make up for the mass of the data drives Xuannu mentioned just now, but then we still have Xinghuan's, Yuwang's, and the other agents' backups...

spans.text: We can use the stuff in the ship to make up for the mass of the data drives Xuannu mentioned just now, but then we still have Xinghuan's, Yuwang's, and the other agents' backups...

units.rawText: If the time comes and the mass we brought along can't make up for the shortfall, then I...
units.displayText: If the time comes and the mass we brought along can't make up for the shortfall, then I...

spans.text: If the time comes and the mass we brought along can't make up for the shortfall, then I...

units.rawText: Hehe, when you think about it, maybe it's a good thing that I gained weight recently. I guess it's worthwhile so everyone can see each other again...
units.displayText: Hehe, when you think about it, maybe it's a good thing that I gained weight recently. I guess it's worthwhile so everyone can see each other again...

spans.text: Hehe, when you think about it, maybe it's a good thing that I gained weight recently. I guess it's worthwhile so everyone can see each other again...

units.rawText: I guess... I'll become the last piece of the puzzle that resets the Jiutian sector.
units.displayText: I guess... I'll become the last piece of the puzzle that resets the Jiutian sector.

spans.text: I guess... I'll become the last piece of the puzzle that resets the Jiutian sector.

units.rawText: Hubble looks at the purple void. It is completely different from how it was in the Oasis' simulated universe; searing hot, utterly dark, silent, and filled with despair.
units.displayText: Hubble looks at the purple void. It is completely different from how it was in the Oasis' simulated universe; searing hot, utterly dark, silent, and filled with despair.

spans.text: Hubble looks at the purple void. It is completely different from how it was in the Oasis' simulated universe; searing hot, utterly dark, silent, and filled with despair.

units.rawText: But the spaceship that carries hope with it has flown far away by now.
units.displayText: But the spaceship that carries hope with it has flown far away by now.

spans.text: But the spaceship that carries hope with it has flown far away by now.

units.rawText: I wonder... how will the universe look like after it's reset?
units.displayText: I wonder... how will the universe look like after it's reset?

spans.text: I wonder... how will the universe look like after it's reset?

units.rawText: I'm sure... it'll be a world that fascinates the brand new me, just like before.
units.displayText: I'm sure... it'll be a world that fascinates the brand new me, just like before.

spans.text: I'm sure... it'll be a world that fascinates the brand new me, just like before.

units.rawText: Mass elimination progress updated. Commencing sector reset...
units.displayText: Mass elimination progress updated. Commencing sector reset...

spans.text: Mass elimination progress updated. Commencing sector reset...

units.rawText: The darkness slowly covers up the endless purple, and in that moment, all things are silent. In this vast firmament, there is no way to tell the land from the sea. They seem to be drifting apart, yet approaching each other without a sound.
units.displayText: The darkness slowly covers up the endless purple, and in that moment, all things are silent. In this vast firmament, there is no way to tell the land from the sea. They seem to be drifting apart, yet approaching each other without a sound.

spans.text: The darkness slowly covers up the endless purple, and in that moment, all things are silent. In this vast firmament, there is no way to tell the land from the sea. They seem to be drifting apart, yet approaching each other without a sound.

units.rawText: All energy gathers into a point in the void, and a blinding light shatters the darkness.
units.displayText: All energy gathers into a point in the void, and a blinding light shatters the darkness.

spans.text: All energy gathers into a point in the void, and a blinding light shatters the darkness.

units.rawText: The sudden supernova releases immense quantities of energy, which stirs up the molecular clouds. The power of gravity causes these nebulae to collapse on themselves.
units.displayText: The sudden supernova releases immense quantities of energy, which stirs up the molecular clouds. The power of gravity causes these nebulae to collapse on themselves.

spans.text: The sudden supernova releases immense quantities of energy, which stirs up the molecular clouds. The power of gravity causes these nebulae to collapse on themselves.

units.rawText: As time goes by, the nebulae rotate faster and faster, while mass gradually accumulates. Hydrogen fusion begins in their hyper-dense cores, and a primordial Sun is born.
units.displayText: As time goes by, the nebulae rotate faster and faster, while mass gradually accumulates. Hydrogen fusion begins in their hyper-dense cores, and a primordial Sun is born.

spans.text: As time goes by, the nebulae rotate faster and faster, while mass gradually accumulates. Hydrogen fusion begins in their hyper-dense cores, and a primordial Sun is born.

units.rawText: The pull of gravity slowly shapes the planets and locks them into their orbits. After much time passes, the Solar System finally reaches its current state.
units.displayText: The pull of gravity slowly shapes the planets and locks them into their orbits. After much time passes, the Solar System finally reaches its current state.

spans.text: The pull of gravity slowly shapes the planets and locks them into their orbits. After much time passes, the Solar System finally reaches its current state.

units.rawText: It is as though a pair of invisible, yet gentle hands were working in the void, slowly restoring the broken remnants of creation to wholeness. In this way, the universe is reincarnated and reborn, with only a solitary spaceship floating powerlessly in the void...
units.displayText: It is as though a pair of invisible, yet gentle hands were working in the void, slowly restoring the broken remnants of creation to wholeness. In this way, the universe is reincarnated and reborn, with only a solitary spaceship floating powerlessly in the void...
